item.title: Hank Kunneman Says Christians Must Tell Trump Critics To 'Shut Up'
item.description: MAGA cultist/self-proclaimed "prophet" Hank Kunneman claims that reports that Trump is unpopular is "demonic chatter" and that "it's time for us who love God and love our country, love our children, love morals, love sanity" to tell Trump's critics to "shut up."

item.title: 'Pray For The Midterms': MAGA Cultist Lance Wallnau Warns The Election Could Be A 'Bloodbath'
item.description: MAGA cultist Lance Wallnau says Trump recently asked a group of evangelicals visiting the White House to "pray for the midterms," after which religious-right election guru Ralph Reed warned that the GOP is potentially facing a "bloodbath."
